QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Performance and Benchmarking_31

question.text: Godavari VC AIF (PIC INR 50 cr). End-of-year Net AUM: Y1 56.42, Y2 63.30, Y3 75.09, Y4 87.86 (all INR cr), zero distributions till Y4. In Y5, distribution of INR 102.62 cr and AUM = 0. TVPI at Y4 is closest to:

explanation.text: The Logic: RVPI = AUM / PIC and TVPI = DPI + RVPI per the workbook (pages 153-155). At Y4: RVPI = 87.86 / 50 = 1.7572, approximately 1.76. DPI at Y4 = 0 because no distributions have been made yet, so TVPI = 0 + 1.76 = 1.76. This matches the best-case in Example 7.2 of the source. The Trap: 1.13 is the Y1 RVPI (56.42 / 50). 1.50 is the Y3 RVPI (75.09 / 50). 2.05 is the Y5 DPI once the INR 102.62 crore distribution is made (102.62 / 50). Note: The ratios and Example 7.2 worked numbers are in pages 153-156; the 2.05 distractor maps to post-liquidation DPI rather than the Y4 measurement point asked in the stem.
